requested_by_user: Luna High subagent versus Gemini using identical PDF and evidence; retain running Gemini process; compare before adoption
quality_scope: One first QuestionSet draft from each model on each completed Gemini evidence set. Same captured application prompt, eligible anchors, schema, and selected-page PNG bytes. Separate frozen full Gemini workflow results include any repair rounds.
blinding: Each Luna worker has a fresh context and cannot read Gemini questions, results, metrics, gold or other document outputs. Parent source reviewer is not blind to model identity; this is not an independent human evaluation.
hard_pass: no unsupported premises in question, intent or listen_for
additional_review: useful explanation of judgment rather than source recitation
tokens: Gemini provider usageMetadata and Luna dedicated-session token_count counters only. Missing fields remain null/unverified. Luna output_tokens includes reasoning_output_tokens; never double count reasoning. Session counters include tool/image loading and agent overhead.
retries: Record generation batches, schema/application retries separately from model/tool turns. Provider-internal retries are unobservable for Luna and remain null.
cost: Gemini usage-based standard API cost estimate, including thought tokens and retries. Luna actual Codex charge and cost per passed question remain null unless authoritative billing exists; public API price is not the Codex charge. Zero passed questions produce an undefined cost per pass, never zero.
limitations: Shared upstream Gemini extraction, not a test of Luna PDF extraction
Different platform/system/tool wrappers and reasoning settings
Potential image resize by the agent client
Known six-document regression sample, not general model accuracy
